gloss: to tell; to let someone hear

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {聞|き}かしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to tell; to let someone hear
definitions.explanation: To tell or relate something to someone. A causative-like form of 聞く, meaning to make or allow someone to hear information, a story, or music.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かせた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I told the children an old folk tale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{土産話|みやげばなし}→土産話：23123_miyagebanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}かせた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I told my friend stories from my trip.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧、⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{絵本|えほん}→絵本：10429_ehon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{聞|き}かせて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She reads picture books aloud to her child every night before bed.

notes:
{聞|き}かす is a transitive godan verb. It functions as the causative form of ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧, though it is a distinct lexical item rather than a grammatical causative.

ASPECT (ている):
⟦{聞|き}かせている→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ indicates an ongoing action of telling or playing something for someone to hear.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [person]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧[thing]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かせる→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (tell someone something)
- [person]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}かせる→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (let someone hear)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かせる→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (tell a story)
- ⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かせる→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (sing a song for someone)
- {読|よ}み{聞|き}かせる (read aloud to someone)

The て form ⟦{聞|き}かせて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ is very common in conversation: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かせて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧ (Tell me a good story). The compound ⟦{読|よ}み{聞|き}かせ→読み聞かせ：10631_yomikikase⟧ is a standard term for reading aloud to children.
